headline: Pressure on the restaurant sector in 2026: Turnover falls due to inflation too
summary: Greek restaurant turnover is falling in 2026 as consumers cut back on dining out amid rising living costs. Inflation is cited as a factor in the decline.
why: Restaurant spending is a sensitive indicator of household consumption, which makes up a large share of Greece's economy. Weaker demand affects hospitality companies and tourism-linked businesses.
